high_level_description: The image depicts an intricately carved wooden cabinet with a traditional design, likely used as a home altar or shrine. The cabinet is richly detailed with ornate carvings on the doors and top, featuring floral motifs and symmetrical patterns. The top of the cabinet has four small finials, adding to its decorative appeal. There are small bells attached to the carvings on the doors, which are often used for prayer or meditation purposes. The cabinet has two doors with peacock-shaped handles, symbolizing grace and beauty in many cultures.
